# 74163 - Fully synchronous binary counter

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74163.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74163.json)

| 15 | RIPPLE CARRY OUTPUT | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 14,13,12,11 | QA,QB,QC,QD = counter state bits 0..3 | QA is the least significant bit. |
| 15 | RIPPLE CARRY OUTPUT = ENABLE T AND QA AND QB AND QC AND QD | High at count 15 while ENABLE T is high; the pulse lasts about as long as the high part of QA. Used to enable the next stage. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR low: QA-QD = 0 at the next rising clock edge, regardless of load and enable inputs
- else LOAD low: QA,QB,QC,QD = A,B,C,D at the next rising clock edge, regardless of the enable inputs
- else ENABLE P and ENABLE T both high: count up by one (binary, 0-15, wraps to 0) at each rising clock edge
- else (P or T low): hold
- Low-to-high transitions at LOAD should be avoided while the clock is low if the enable inputs are high at or before the transition
- Low-to-high transitions at CLEAR should be avoided while the clock is low if the enable and load inputs are high at or before the transition
- High-to-low transitions at ENABLE P or T should occur only while the clock is high

## Not known

- The ripple-carry formula is from the description text (T fed forward, high-level overflow pulse at the maximum count); the logic diagram page was not read gate by gate.

## Notes

Binary counter with synchronous clear (fully synchronous).

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54160 thru SN54163 ... SN74160 thru SN74163 Synchronous 4-bit counters, bulletin DL-S 7611385 (October 1976)](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - book pages 7-190, 7-196, 7-197 (PDF pages 189, 195, 196); SN74163
